summary.text: Jason Stephens is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 93 since October 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as insurance agent.

paragraphs.text: Jason Stephens attended David Lipscomb University, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as insurance agent.
He assumed office in the Ohio House on October 10, 2019, succeeding Ryan Smith.
In the 2023–2024 session he chaired the Legislative Service Commission, the House Rules and Reference Committee and the Joint Legislative Ethics Committee.
For 2025–2026 he was assigned to the Financial Institutions, Medicaid, Government Oversight and Local Government committees.
Stephens defeated Larry Kidd in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary, 62.6% to 37.4%, and faces Democrat Jessica Harper in the general election.
